resources.string: The meaning of the Arabic word, right where you selected it. Dictionaries are prepared on this device, never in the cloud.
What an entry and the «Add to Anki» button look like

Every dictionary has its own licence, so the APK ships no dictionary entries. The release contains only code and instructions. All dictionaries are prepared locally on this device from files you download yourself.

The official CAMeL morphology archive, calima-msa-r13, 40 MB, GPL-2. It is converted on this device with one button in the import wizard. The KSAA dictionary (معجم الرياض), Hans Wehr and Kaikki are built by scripts in the repository. Without packs the app still works, but it shows no entries.

Select an Arabic word in any app and choose «Dictionary» in the selection menu. A popup opens with one to three entries. Every sense has an «Add to Anki» button: the card goes into the deck you choose. The floating button is optional and is off by default.
Packs are stored on this device only. The app does not download dictionary data from the network.
Word form analysis and lemmas. Built on this device from the official CAMeL-Lab archive.
The main Arabic-Arabic dictionary. Built on this device; the text is not redistributed.
English glosses. CC BY-SA 4.0. Built with tools/build_kaikki_index.py.
English senses. Built with tools/build_hw_pack.py. The file is not redistributed.
Cards from the popup go to AnkiDroid on this phone, or to Anki on your computer via the haqomu.apkg file.
Download haqomu.apkg from the GitHub Releases page of the project.
Open the file or use Share and send it to AnkiDroid. The Haqomu deck and note type appear automatically.
On your computer open the same file: Anki Desktop imports the same deck and the same note type.
Cards from the popup will go to the deck selected below. You can change the target deck at any time.
The haqomu.apkg file appears in GitHub Releases with the first build. Right now the repository contains code only.
The deck the app sends cards to. Defaults to Haqomu.
To add cards on your computer you can enable AnkiConnect in Anki Desktop. This is optional: export via .apkg works without it.
The size applies to dictionary entries in the popup.
Arrives in the next build. The accessibility service reads only the sentence around the selection; the text is never saved or sent anywhere.
A dictionary magnifier for Arabic text. Select a word in any app, choose «Dictionary», and get the meaning. No server, no accounts, no ads.
github.com/bernkastel5/Haqomu. The code is distributed under the GPL-3.0 license.
CAMeL Tools and the calima-msa-r13 database: GPL-2
معجم الرياض للغة العربية, King Salman Global Academy for Arabic Language. The text is not redistributed.
Hans Wehr, A Dictionary of Modern Written Arabic. © Harrassowitz Verlag. The text is not redistributed.
Word form analysis ported from camel-tools: GPL-3.

The app sends nothing to the network. The only exceptions: downloading the optional model via your button (arrives with the model) and building the morphology pack from the official CAMeL archive on this device.
Screen text is used only to find the sentence around the selected word. It is never stored.

One button: download official copies from the sources, convert on-device, verify and install. Nothing is sent from your device.
